Ph.D. in Mathematics
Apply Now
Prepare to pursue a successful research career as a professional mathematician with the Ph.D. in Mathematics. You will be prepared for careers in academia, industry, government labs, or the financial sector.
This program provides a rigorous and thorough education in a very dynamic and interactive environment. You will conduct research in one of the diverse areas of our faculty's expertise.
You will gain broad exposure to graduate-level mathematics, as well as thorough experience in mathematical research. You will leave with extensive training and in-depth knowledge in an area of specialization. The program also provides internship opportunities, an array of research seminars, working seminars, and teaching experiences.
Ph.D. in Mathematics Program Requirements
Careers
The current need for employees with strong skills in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) is well-documented. Our program prepares students to take on a wide variety of STEM jobs.
Our program will prepare you to assume leadership positions as a researcher in academia, industry, government labs and similar settings.
Earning Your Doctoral Degree
You will produce a final dissertation consisting of original work that clearly represents a relevant contribution to the advancement of the corresponding field of study.
